services.name: Torch River Shack Apartment Rental
services.desc: The AMAZING apartment is newly remodeled this year! Duration Weekly Rentals About Stay here and you will enjoy breath taking views of Torch River and Torch Lake. A quaint two-bedroom, one bath apartment located above the Torch River Shack right on the Torch River, just walking distance (~500 feet) from the Famous Torch Lake Sandbar. With a twin sized pullout extra oversized chair, it can sleep up to seven people. Parking for two cars but no RVs please. Boat Trailer parking is possible offsite. This is a weekly rental from May - October that rents Friday to Friday. We recommend you bring your boat to fully enjoy the gorgeous Torch Lake waters.
